children.value: This chapter centered on a critical component of bond pricing: Accrued Interest. To tackle this, we developed and deployed several new custom Python functions. While their immediate purpose was to demonstrate and automate accrued interest calculations, these tools are built for scale and will handle the heavy lifting in future chapters as our financial models grow more complex.

We also introduced the “Iceberg Principle” as a major advantage of utilizing Python’s abundant libraries and modules. This concept highlights how we can leverage incredibly complex, pre-written code just beneath the surface, allowing us to focus our energy on the financial mechanics at the visible “tip” of the iceberg. This principle remains a cornerstone of our methodology and a key driver for effective, streamlined learning.
: Mastered the mechanics of allocating coupon payments and bridging the gap between clean quotes and dirty transaction prices.
: Built robust, reusable Python tools that will serve as the foundation for advanced fixed-income modeling down the road.
: Embraced Python’s massive ecosystem to streamline our workflow, learning the financial intuition without getting bogged down in the underlying computer science.
